`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/AddressNormalizer.java` (package-private helper):
```java
final class AddressNormalizer {
    private static final Map<String, String> ABBREVIATIONS =
            Map.of("ST", "STREET", "RD", "ROAD", "AVE", "AVENUE");
    static String normalize(String value) {
        if (value == null) return "";
        String collapsed = value.trim().replaceAll("\\s+", " ").toUpperCase(Locale.ROOT);
        if (collapsed.isEmpty()) return "";
        String[] tokens = collapsed.split(" ");
        StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder(collapsed.length());
        for (int i = 0; i < tokens.length; i++) {
            if (i > 0) sb.append(' ');
            String expanded = ABBREVIATIONS.get(tokens[i]);
            sb.append(expanded != null ? expanded : tokens[i]);
        }
        return sb.toString();
    }
}
```
Rules: trim, collapse internal whitespace, upper-case, expand whole-word `ST→STREET`, `RD→ROAD`, `AVE→AVENUE`. Idempotent; null/blank → "".

`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/NormalizeOwnerAddress.java` — POST-only step that writes the normalized address back onto the body in place (`request.setAddress(AddressNormalizer.normalize(request.getAddress()))`), so Build/Save store it and AssignHousehold hashes the normalized value. **Note: the PUT pipeline does NOT run this step** (see wiring below).

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when supplied it
            must be a syntactically valid address and is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'george.franklin@example.com'
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: A 4-digit postal code. Optional; when supplied it must be four
            digits and, for a city with a known region (Sydney->NSW 2000-2099,
            Melbourne->VIC 3000-3099, Brisbane->QLD 4000-4099), fall within that region's
            range. A city with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode. Stored and
            returned when given.
          type: string
          pattern: "^[0-9]{4}$"
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the pet owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD'
            format. Optional on create; defaults to the server's current date when omitted.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: The pet owner's date of birth, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. Optional;
            when supplied it drives the derived 'ageBand'.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: When true, allow creating this owner even though another owner
            already has the same last name and address (they share a household).
            Write-only; not stored and never returned.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: The stored E.164 'telephone' formatted for humans, derived at read
                time as the country code, a space, then the national digits grouped in threes
                from the left. The raw 'telephone' stays in E.164 form.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName,
                dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: A business identifier formatted '<REGION>-<HASH8>', where REGION
                is the canonical region derived from the postcode and HASH8 is the first
                eight upper-case hex characters of SHA-256 over the normalized telephone
                concatenated with lastName. Content-derived and carries no sequence number.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-1A2B3C4D'
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: A single Luhn check digit (0..9) computed at read time over the
                digits contained in customerCode.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 4
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: A membership identifier formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>', where
                YY is the last two digits of the registrationDate year. Assigned at creation.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-1A2B3C4D-M26'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: A stable shared identifier for owners who share a household
                (same last name and address). Assigned when an owner is created with
                'sharesHousehold=true' to join an existing same-household owner; both
                housemates then carry the same value. Absent for owners not in a shared
                household.
              type: string
              example: 'A1B2C3D4E5F6'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: The number of existing owners that, at the moment this owner was
                created, already shared the same firstName and lastName (compared
                case-insensitively). Zero when the name was unique.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: The owner's loyalty points, derived at read time. Starts at 0,
                gains 2 when an email is present, gains 1 when namesakeCount is 0, gains 2
                for a household of 3 or more, and gains 3 for a tenure over 365 days.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: The owner's numeric loyalty level (1..4), derived at read time
                from membershipPoints. Maps membershipPoints to a level as 1 (0-1 points),
                2 (2-3), 3 (4-5), 4 (6 or more). Because a newly created owner has zero
                tenure, a new owner can reach at most 5 points and so never exceeds level 3.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: The canonical region, read at request time from the REGION prefix
                of the region-and-hash customerCode so it always agrees with the identity.
                When no customerCode is present it is derived directly, preferring the
                postcode range (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099) and falling
                back to the city-to-region table (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC,
                Brisbane->QLD), or 'UNKNOWN' when neither resolves a region.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: The IANA timezone name for the owner's locality/region, derived at
                read time from the fixed region-to-timezone table (NSW->Australia/Sydney,
                VIC->Australia/Melbourne, QLD->Australia/Brisbane). Absent when the region
                resolves to no table entry (e.g. 'UNKNOWN').
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: The preferred contact channel, derived at read time. 'EMAIL'
                when the owner has a non-blank email, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: The owner's age band, derived at read time from 'birthDate'
                measured against 'registrationDate'. 'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' from
                18 to 64, 'SENIOR' at 65 or older. Absent when no birthDate was supplied.
              type: string
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: Derived at read time. True when more than 80 owners have already
                been created on the current business day, otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: Assigned at creation. True when this owner, though not a hard
                duplicate, shares an existing owner's lastName and postcode while having a
                different telephone; otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: The id of the existing owner this owner soft-matched at creation
                (lowest matching id when several match). Present only when
                'possibleDuplicate' is true.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: The owner's derived duplicate-detection key, formed as
                'normalizedTelephone|email|householdId' (the email segment empty when the
                owner has no email, the householdId segment empty when the owner is not in a
                shared household). Two owners may not share the same whole identityKey.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678||A1B2C3D4E5F6'
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets
    OwnerPage:
      title: Owner page
      description: A page of pet owners.
      type: object
      properties:
        content:
          title: Content
          description: Pet owners in the requested page.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/Owner'
        page:
          title: Page
          description: Zero-based page index.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 0
        size:
          title: Size
          description: Requested page size.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 1
          example: 5
        totalElements:
          title: Total elements
          description: Total number of owners matching the request.
          type: integer
          format: int64
          minimum: 0
          example: 10
        totalPages:
          title: Total pages
          description: Total number of pages matching the request.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 2
      required:
        - content
        - page
        - size
        - totalElements
        - totalPages
    PetPage:
      title: Pet page
      description: A page of pets.
      type: object
      properties:
        content:
          title: Content
          description: Pets in the requested page.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
        page:
          title: Page
          description: Zero-based page index.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 0
        size:
          title: Size
          description: Requested page size.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 1
          example: 5
        totalElements:
          title: Total elements
          description: Total number of pets matching the request.
          type: integer
          format: int64
          minimum: 0
          example: 10
        totalPages:
          title: Total pages
          description: Total number of pages matching the request.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 2
      required:
        - content
        - page
        - size
        - totalElements
        - totalPages
    PetFields:
      title: Pet fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet.
      type: object
      properties:
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the pet.
          type: string
          maxLength: 30
          example: Leo
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: The date of birth of the pet.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2010-09-07'
          x-field-extra-annotation: "@org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.validation.PetAgeValidation"
        type:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/PetType'
      required:
        - name
        - birthDate
        - type
    Pet:
      title: Pet
      description: A pet.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/PetFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            ownerId:
              title: Owner ID
              description: The ID of the pet's owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string

            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: The stored E.164 'telephone' formatted for humans, derived at read

                from the left. The raw 'telephone' stays in E.164 form.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'

              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName,
                dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'

            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: A business identifier formatted '<REGION>-<HASH8>', where REGION
                is the canonical region derived from the postcode and HASH8 is the first
                eight upper-case hex characters of SHA-256 over the normalized telephone
                concatenated with lastName. Content-derived and carries no sequence number.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-1A2B3C4D'
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit

                digits contained in customerCode.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 4
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number

              type: string

              title: Household ID

                housemates then carry the same value. Absent for owners not in a shared
                household.
              type: string
              example: 'A1B2C3D4E5F6'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: The number of existing owners that, at the moment this owner was
                created, already shared the same firstName and lastName (compared
                case-insensitively). Zero when the name was unique.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: The owner's loyalty points, derived at read time. Starts at 0,
                gains 2 when an email is present, gains 1 when namesakeCount is 0, gains 2
                for a household of 3 or more, and gains 3 for a tenure over 365 days.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: The owner's numeric loyalty level (1..4), derived at read time
                from membershipPoints. Maps membershipPoints to a level as 1 (0-1 points),
                2 (2-3), 3 (4-5), 4 (6 or more). Because a newly created owner has zero
                tenure, a new owner can reach at most 5 points and so never exceeds level 3.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: The canonical region, read at request time from the REGION prefix
                of the region-and-hash customerCode so it always agrees with the identity.
                When no customerCode is present it is derived directly, preferring the
                postcode range (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099) and falling
                back to the city-to-region table (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC,
                Brisbane->QLD), or 'UNKNOWN' when neither resolves a region.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: The IANA timezone name for the owner's locality/region, derived at
                read time from the fixed region-to-timezone table (NSW->Australia/Sydney,
                VIC->Australia/Melbourne, QLD->Australia/Brisbane). Absent when the region
                resolves to no table entry (e.g. 'UNKNOWN').
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: The preferred contact channel, derived at read time. 'EMAIL'
                when the owner has a non-blank email, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: The owner's age band, derived at read time from 'birthDate'
                measured against 'registrationDate'. 'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' from
                18 to 64, 'SENIOR' at 65 or older. Absent when no birthDate was supplied.
              type: string
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: Derived at read time. True when more than 80 owners have already
                been created on the current business day, otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: Assigned at creation. True when this owner, though not a hard
                duplicate, shares an existing owner's lastName and postcode while having a
                different telephone; otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:

                'possibleDuplicate' is true.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:

              type: string
              example: '+61412345678||A1B2C3D4E5F6'
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:

              readOnly: true
          required:

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS vets (
  id INT(4) UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  first_name VARCHAR(30),
  last_name VARCHAR(30),
  INDEX(last_name)
) engine=InnoDB;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS specialties (
  id INT(4) UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  name VARCHAR(80),
  INDEX(name)
) engine=InnoDB;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS vet_specialties (
  vet_id INT(4) UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
  specialty_id INT(4) UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
  FOREIGN KEY (vet_id) REFERENCES vets(id),
  FOREIGN KEY (specialty_id) REFERENCES specialties(id),
  UNIQUE (vet_id,specialty_id)
) engine=InnoDB;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS types (
  id INT(4) UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  name VARCHAR(80),
  INDEX(name)
) engine=InnoDB;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS owners (
  id INT(4) UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  first_name VARCHAR(30),
  last_name VARCHAR(30),

  telephone VARCHAR(20),

  registration_date DATE,

  household_id VARCHAR(64),
  namesake_count INTEGER,
  possible_duplicate BOOLEAN,
  possible_duplicate_of INTEGER,
  INDEX(last_name)
) engine=InnoDB;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS pets (
  id INT(4) UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  name VARCHAR(30),
  birth_date DATE,
  type_id INT(4) UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
  owner_id INT(4) UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
  INDEX(name),
  FOREIGN KEY (owner_id) REFERENCES owners(id),

) engine=InnoDB;

  pet_id INT(4) UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
  visit_date DATE,
  description VARCHAR(255),
  FOREIGN KEY (pet_id) REFERENCES pets(id)
) engine=InnoDB;

  username VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL ,
  password VARCHAR(60) NOT NULL ,
  enabled TINYINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 ,

) engine=InnoDB;

 * address, city or telephone is missing or blank with a 400 whose {@code errors} array
 * names each offending field. Bean validation still runs first (via {@code @Valid}) so
 * pattern/size failures keep their existing behaviour; this step additionally catches
 * whitespace-only values that slip past {@code @Size(min = 1)}. An address may be supplied
 * in either form — a structured {@code addressLine1} or the flat {@code address} — and is
 * required in at least one; it is checked in its normalized form (see
 * {@link AddressNormalizer}), so a value blank after normalization is rejected too.
 * Publishes the validated body for {@link BuildOwner}.

The full test suite passes: **55 tests, 0 failures, 0 errors, BUILD SUCCESS**.

## Summary

I added a structured address form to the create-owner endpoint while keeping the flat `address` input working. Changes:

**API contract** (`src/main/resources/openapi.yml`)
- Added optional `addressLine1` and `addressLine2` string properties to `OwnerFields` (so they appear on both the request DTO and the response `Owner`).
- Removed `address` from the `required` list, so a structured-only payload is no longer rejected by bean validation. The `address` field's description now documents it as the composed, normalized read value.

**Validation** (`ValidateOwnerFields.java`)
- An owner is now valid when it supplies an address in *either* form: a non-blank normalized `addressLine1` or a non-blank normalized flat `address`. City/firstName/lastName/telephone requirements are unchanged, so earlier minimal owners are still accepted.

**Normalization + composition** (`NormalizeOwnerAddress.java`)
- When `addressLine1` is present, both lines are normalized (upper-case, whitespace collapse, `ST→STREET` etc.) and the entity's `address` is set to the composed string — normalized `addressLine1`, plus a single space and normalized `addressLine2` when `addressLine2` is present. Otherwise the flat `address` is normalized on its own. Because everything downstream (household hash, postcode validation, locality) reads the already-composed `address`/`postcode`/`city`, it transparently uses the structured fields when present and falls back to the flat address.

**Persistence** (`Owner.java` + `db/*/schema.sql`, `db/hsqldb/data.sql`)
- Added `addressLine1`/`addressLine2` fields and `address_line1`/`address_line2` columns so the structured lines round-trip through GET (MapStruct maps them by name). For hsqldb (the test DB, which uses positional `INSERT`s) I placed the new columns at the end of the table and appended two trailing NULLs to the seed inserts.

The four spec tests (Cp01 either-form/missing-city rejection, Cp12/Cp44 normalization + composition + flat-address backward compat, Cp30 locality from structured postcode) and all 51 other tests are green.
